name: airbnb-market-cli
description: Node.js CLI tool for scraping, deduplicating, classifying high-rise condos, and exporting comparative Excel reports from airbnb.com.vn for OTA Arbitrage market research.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:prod" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
